service: uniapply-app
frameworkVersion: "3"

plugins:
  - serverless-esbuild
  - serverless-s3-sync
  - serverless-cloudfront-invalidate
  - serverless-domain-manager

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: us-east-1
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - ${param:appBaseUrl}
        - ${param:localDevUrl}
      allowedMethods: [GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS]
      allowedHeaders: [Authorization, Content-Type]
      exposeHeaders: []
      maxAge: 86400
  environment:
    REGION: ${self:provider.region}
    STAGE: ${sls:stage}
    # DynamoDB tables
    USERS_TABLE: ${self:service}-users-${sls:stage}
    FORMS_TABLE: ${self:service}-forms-${sls:stage}
    APPLICATIONS_TABLE: ${self:service}-applications-${sls:stage}
    ROLES_TABLE: ${self:service}-roles-${sls:stage}
    AUDIT_TABLE: ${self:service}-audit-${sls:stage}
    # Buckets (resolve actual names by Ref)
    WEB_BUCKET: { Ref: WebBucket }
    UPLOADS_BUCKET: { Ref: UploadsBucket }
    # Cognito + SES
    USER_POOL_ID: { Ref: CognitoUserPool }
    USER_POOL_CLIENT_ID: { Ref: CognitoUserPoolClient }
    SES_SENDER_EMAIL: no-reply@uniapply.app
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        # DynamoDB (tables + GSIs)
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
            - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.USERS_TABLE}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.FORMS_TABLE}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.APPLICATIONS_TABLE}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.ROLES_TABLE}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.AUDIT_TABLE}
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.APPLICATIONS_TABLE}/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:${aws:accountId}:table/${self:provider.environment.USERS_TABLE}/index/*
        # S3 (only our two buckets)
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:DeleteObject
            - s3:ListBucket
          Resource:
            - { "Fn::GetAtt": [WebBucket, Arn] }
            - { "Fn::Join": ["", [{ "Fn::GetAtt": [WebBucket, Arn] }, "/*"]] }
            - { "Fn::GetAtt": [UploadsBucket, Arn] }
            - {
                "Fn::Join":
                  ["", [{ "Fn::GetAtt": [UploadsBucket, Arn] }, "/*"]],
              }
        # SES (send only)
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - ses:SendEmail
            - ses:SendRawEmail
          Resource: "*"
        # Cognito (read-only)
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
            - cognito-idp:ListUsers
            - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPool
          Resource:
            - { "Fn::GetAtt": [CognitoUserPool, Arn] }
  tags:
    Service: ${self:service}
    Stage: ${sls:stage}

# ✅ Stage-specific params
params:
  default:
    # Fallbacks (used if no stage override present)
    apiDomainName: api.uniapply.app
    appBaseUrl: https://uniapply.app
    localDevUrl: http://localhost:5173
  dev:
    # Use a separate dev API domain (or comment this out to skip custom domain in dev)
    apiDomainName: dev-api.uniapply.app
    # Frontend dev runs locally; Cognito callbacks use this too
    appBaseUrl: http://localhost:5173
    localDevUrl: http://localhost:5173
  prod:
    apiDomainName: api.uniapply.app
    appBaseUrl: https://uniapply.app
    localDevUrl: http://localhost:5173

package:
  individually: true

custom:
  esbuild:
    bundle: true
    minify: true
    target: node20
    sourcemap: true
    exclude:
      - aws-sdk
  s3Sync:
    - bucketName: ${cf:${self:service}-${sls:stage}.WebBucketName}
      localDir: ./frontend/dist
  cloudfrontInvalidate:
    - distributionIdKey: WebDistributionId
      items:
        - "/*"
  # API custom domain (HTTP API)
  customDomain:
    domainName: ${param:apiDomainName}
    basePath: ""
    stage: ${sls:stage}
    createRoute53Record: true
    endpointType: regional
    apiType: http

functions:
  api:
    handler: src/handler.main
    memorySize: 512
    timeout: 15
    architecture: arm64
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /{proxy+}
          method: ANY

  presignUpload:
    handler: src/handler.presignUpload
    memorySize: 256
    timeout: 10
    architecture: arm64
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /files/presign
          method: POST

  notifyStatusChange:
    handler: src/handler.notifyStatusChange
    memorySize: 256
    timeout: 10
    architecture: arm64

resources:
  Resources:
    # DynamoDB (SSE + PITR enabled)
    UsersTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.USERS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: email
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        SSESpecification:
          SSEEnabled: true
        PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
          PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: email-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: email
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }
      DeletionPolicy: Retain
      UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    FormsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.FORMS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        SSESpecification:
          SSEEnabled: true
        PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
          PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      DeletionPolicy: Retain
      UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    ApplicationsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.APPLICATIONS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: status
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        SSESpecification:
          SSEEnabled: true
        PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
          PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: userId-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: userId
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }
          - IndexName: status-index
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: status
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection: { ProjectionType: ALL }
      DeletionPolicy: Retain
      UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    RolesTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.ROLES_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: roleName
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: roleName
            KeyType: HASH
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        SSESpecification:
          SSEEnabled: true
        PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
          PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      DeletionPolicy: Retain
      UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    AuditLogsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.AUDIT_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        SSESpecification:
          SSEEnabled: true
        PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
          PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      DeletionPolicy: Retain
      UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    # S3 Buckets (SSE + Versioning) with restricted CORS
    WebBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        OwnershipControls:
          Rules:
            - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
        PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
          BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        BucketEncryption:
          ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
            - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                SSEAlgorithm: AES256
        VersioningConfiguration:
          Status: Enabled
        CorsConfiguration:
          CorsRules:
            - AllowedOrigins:
                - ${param:appBaseUrl}
                - ${param:localDevUrl}
              AllowedMethods: [GET, HEAD]
              AllowedHeaders: ["*"]
      DeletionPolicy: Retain
      UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    UploadsBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        OwnershipControls:
          Rules:
            - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
        PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
          BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        BucketEncryption:
          ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
            - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                SSEAlgorithm: AES256
        VersioningConfiguration:
          Status: Enabled
        CorsConfiguration:
          CorsRules:
            - AllowedOrigins:
                - ${param:appBaseUrl}
                - ${param:localDevUrl}
              AllowedMethods: [GET, PUT]
              AllowedHeaders: ["*"]
              ExposedHeaders: ["ETag"]
      DeletionPolicy: Retain
      UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    # CloudFront + OAC (security headers policy enabled)
    CloudFrontOAC:
      Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
      Properties:
        OriginAccessControlConfig:
          Name: ${self:service}-${sls:stage}-oac
          OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
          SigningBehavior: always
          SigningProtocol: sigv4

    WebDistribution:
      Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
      Properties:
        DistributionConfig:
          Enabled: true
          DefaultRootObject: index.html
          Origins:
            - Id: WebBucketOrigin
              DomainName: { "Fn::GetAtt": [WebBucket, RegionalDomainName] }
              S3OriginConfig: {}
              OriginAccessControlId: { Ref: CloudFrontOAC }
          DefaultCacheBehavior:
            TargetOriginId: WebBucketOrigin
            ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
            AllowedMethods: [GET, HEAD, OPTIONS]
            CachedMethods: [GET, HEAD]
            Compress: true
            CachePolicyId: "658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6"
            ResponseHeadersPolicyId: "67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03" # AWS Managed SecurityHeaders
          PriceClass: PriceClass_100
          ViewerCertificate:
            CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          CustomErrorResponses:
            - ErrorCode: 403
              ResponsePagePath: /index.html
              ResponseCode: 200
              ErrorCachingMinTTL: 0
            - ErrorCode: 404
              ResponsePagePath: /index.html
              ResponseCode: 200
              ErrorCachingMinTTL: 0

    WebBucketPolicy:
      Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
      Properties:
        Bucket: { Ref: WebBucket }
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Sid: AllowCloudFrontRead
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
              Action: s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                { "Fn::Join": ["", [{ "Fn::GetAtt": [WebBucket, Arn] }, "/*"]] }
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  AWS:SourceArn:
                    {
                      "Fn::Join":
                        [
                          "",
                          [
                            "arn:aws:cloudfront::",
                            { Ref: "AWS::AccountId" },
                            ":distribution/",
                            { Ref: WebDistribution },
                          ],
                        ],
                    }

    # Cognito (Callback/Logout URLs driven by params)
    CognitoUserPool:
      Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
      Properties:
        UserPoolName: ${self:service}-${sls:stage}-userpool
        AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
        UsernameAttributes: [email]
        Policies:
          PasswordPolicy:
            MinimumLength: 8
            RequireLowercase: true
            RequireNumbers: true
            RequireSymbols: false
            RequireUppercase: true

    CognitoUserPoolClient:
      Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
      Properties:
        ClientName: ${self:service}-${sls:stage}-client
        UserPoolId: { Ref: CognitoUserPool }
        GenerateSecret: false
        ExplicitAuthFlows:
          [
            ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH,
            ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH,
            ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH,
          ]
        PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
        SupportedIdentityProviders: [COGNITO]
        AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
        AllowedOAuthFlows: [code]
        AllowedOAuthScopes: [email, openid, profile]
        CallbackURLs:
          - ${param:appBaseUrl}
          - ${param:localDevUrl}
        LogoutURLs:
          - ${param:appBaseUrl}
          - ${param:localDevUrl}

    SesEmailIdentity:
      Type: AWS::SES::EmailIdentity
      Properties:
        EmailIdentity: no-reply@uniapply.app

  Outputs:
    WebBucketName:
      Value: { Ref: WebBucket }
    WebDistributionId:
      Value: { Ref: WebDistribution }
    WebDistributionDomain:
      Value: { "Fn::GetAtt": [WebDistribution, DomainName] }
